invariants: The input lineage is reconstructed before any attribution is accepted.
Missing, late, replayed, cross-scope and tampered lineage denies without partial state.
Every declared cause has one explicit bounded witness and exact bound event references.
EXECUTION, TASK_INPUT, EXTERNAL and GOVERNANCE references resolve only to the matching receipt-event type whose digest-valid receipt binds the same scope, task, Decision, class and subtype.
A matching witness label plus KNOWLEDGE_DISPOSITIONED, DECISION_RECORDED or any other unrelated pre-outcome event is insufficient direct evidence.
Knowledge causality requires direct matching profile evidence; outcome contribution alone is insufficient.
SINGLE requires one CONFIRMED or SUPPORTED cause.
MULTI_CONTRIBUTING and MULTI_JOINT retain two or three supported causes without a primary.
ALTERNATIVES_UNRESOLVED retains two or three POSSIBLE causes without a profile fault assignment.
The six profile dimensions remain separate and are returned unchanged by the evaluator.
noSubstitutionRule: A fixture or profile cannot supply missing lineage, a missing causal witness, a missing digest, a broader applicability claim or a fabricated primary cause.
